decisions.claim: a re-delivered save order logs 'saved' twice
decisions.reason: a redelivery is processed again (running set only stops concurrent copies), so a second apply really happens on this machine; one line per apply is the correct record.

decisions.claim: a save that throws (key check or store failure) writes no 'not saved' line
decisions.reason: confirmed in src/agent.ts jobOrder: the outer catch skipped the log. It now records 'not saved' with the first error line, in its own try.

decisions.claim: a crash between setState and the log line loses the line
decisions.reason: real but narrow (process killed inside one synchronous step); the job state itself is right. Noted.
by design and in the spec: the log records changes APPLIED on this machine; the site keeps the owner's action history.
